new_findings_today.title: Destination hero tagline + 'why special' body copy render in English on /hi despite complete Hindi translations existing in the DB for 525/533 destinations
new_findings_today.detail: Section C's narrow check (html lang + Devanagari title only) passed 10/10 as always, but a live Chrome DOM read of wayanad/hi during Section K showed the H1, tagline, and 'WHY SPECIAL' body text all rendering in English while htmlLang correctly read 'hi' and the <title> tag was correctly Devanagari. Investigated further: destinations.translations->'hi' has complete, well-formed name/tagline/why_special Hindi text for wayanad (and, spot-checked, for bidar/dalhousie/medak/mokokchung/old-goa/tura/netarhat/yusmarg/gahirmatha — 9 other of today's 10 sample dests) — none of it reaches the page. A DB-wide aggregate confirms scope: 525/533 destinations (98.5%) have complete hi translations sitting unused; the only 8 without (aritar, dzongu, mangan, nathu-la, phodong, rinchenpong, tashiding, yumthang-valley) are the 8 Sikkim dests added 2026-06-14 — honest scarcity, not part of this bug. Root cause pinpointed in apps/web/src/components/destination-detail-cinematic.tsx: line 131 correctly applies `(locale !== "en" && dest.translations?.[locale]?.name) || dest.name` for the name field, but this identical pattern is never applied to dest.tagline or dest.why_special anywhere in the file (raw fields read directly at lines ~161/163, 274, 297, 376, 473/486, 593/594, 607/624, 1082/1084, 3025/3029) even though the file already has a working localizeRow() helper used for sub-objects (eateries, stays, editor picks). Not a new regression — the file's last 3 commits (07-04, 06-10, 06-03) don't touch translation wiring, so this looks like a long-standing gap that Section C's title/lang-only check was never positioned to catch.
new_findings_today.evidence: Live DOM (https://www.nakshiq.com/hi/destination/wayanad): htmlLang='hi' (correct), h1='Wayanad.' (should be 'वायनाड.'), tagline shown='Prehistoric caves, heart-shaped lake, and the Western Ghats at their wildest' (English, wrong), WHY SPECIAL section fully English. DB: destinations.translations->'hi' for wayanad = {name:'वायनाड', tagline:'प्राचीन गुफाएं, दिल के आकार की झील...', why_special:'केरल का एडवेंचर जिला...'} — unused. DB-wide: total=533, has_hi_tagline=525, has_hi_why_special=525, has_hi_name=525. Full evidence + source line numbers in qa/findings/2026-07-09/NEW-2026-07-09-001-hindi-content-parity.md.
new_findings_today.recommendation: Apply the same `(locale !== "en" && dest.translations?.[locale]?.tagline) || dest.tagline` / `...why_special...` fallback used for `name` (destination-detail-cinematic.tsx line 131) to every dest.tagline / dest.why_special read site in the file (~9 call sites identified). High-value, low-risk fix — the translated data already exists for 525/533 destinations and just needs to be wired in.
